items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Billy Roush and I, he's a very good trauma player, played Smoke Rins with Casalama.

ctx.x: Ordinarily though, you would never tire in a night, would you?

Well, Billy Roush and I, he's a very good trauma player, played Smoke Rins with Casalama. We had a three hour talk one night, he says, you see these guys running around with drugstores and their cases, and they put this on their lip? He says, if you keep yourself moving, he says, Cleen, he says, you'll never have lip trouble, he says. But your stomach is upset, he says, you'll never have trouble. He says, if your stomach upset, you'll start getting fever, cold sores and things. Then these guys put the…
Do you use much pressure, or are you conscious of pressing? It all depends.
